description: I'm Fernando Góes from Brazil, developer of OPHIDIAN VI — a pulsed inductive electric thruster for LEO → LLO cargo missions — and OHM, the AI that supervises it. I bring propulsion, mission design, and interactive simulation. Join us to build a Space Mission Design Game where players design a real mission and face real engineering trade-offs. Looking for 1 developer / NASA data and 1 designer / video storyteller.
